snippet.title: LongStory 2 - Official Release Date Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description:
Are you ready for more LongStory drama? The next installment of this beloved series brings more dates, deeper friendships, trickier dilemmas, and some fascinating surprises!

LongStory 2 will be released on June 26, 2025. Add it to your wishlist on Steam now!
